name: Chaos Queen Ryouko 4 Moriyama Yuri & Ikumi Shimai Heidon Hen
original_name: カオスQueen遼子4 森山由梨＆郁美姉妹併呑編
source:
Shinichi works as a temporary lecturer in a private school. He stays at a private family keeping a glamorous, but unstable position. It's summer now and the family he stays in goes overseas. Suddenly a cute girl Yuri shows up in his life certainly aiming to marry him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
新一在一所私立学校担任临时讲师。他寄宿在一个私人家庭中，保持着光鲜但不稳定的地位。现在是夏天，他寄宿的家庭出国了。突然，一个可爱的女孩由梨出现在他的生活中，显然打算嫁给他。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
